queries.sql:
INSERT INTO run_tests (run, test, result, outcome, signature, attempt, flipped)
		 VALUES ($run, $test, $result, $outcome, $signature, $attempt, $flipped)
		 ON CONFLICT (run, test) DO UPDATE SET result = excluded.result, outcome = excluded.outcome, signature = excluded.signature,
		   attempt = excluded.attempt, flipped = max(run_tests.flipped, excluded.flipped)
		 WHERE excluded.attempt >= run_tests.attempt
SELECT id, outcome FROM results WHERE target = $target AND test = $test ORDER BY attempt DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
plan: SEARCH results USING INDEX results_target (target=? AND test=?)

limits: SQLite pragmas are unchanged production values; baseline is closed before cloning.
All correctness and persisted-count assertions are outside isolated operation timers.
HTTP load generator shares the server process and thread; synchronous writes delay both server work and client callbacks.
Quick HTTP mix is one 15-second window; use the default run for five independent windows.
